meta.title: Feedback | Invessiv
meta.description: Give us feedback on the current state of your project – point by point, with screenshots.

page.heading: Feedback on {project}
page.ownerHint: You can't give feedback in the portal view.
page.readOnlyHint: You can read the feedback but not edit it. Ask the person who looks after the project on your side.

intro.draftVisible: Our team can already see your draft. We only get started once you submit.

none.title: Nothing to review yet
none.description: As soon as we show you a version, you can give feedback here – point by point and with screenshots.

between.title: We're working on the next version
between.description: Your last round is done. As soon as the next version is ready, you'll continue here.

submitted.title: Submitted – we're reviewing your feedback
submitted.description: Thank you. We'll get back to you once we've gone through everything. This round can no longer be changed.

working.title: We're implementing your feedback
working.description: We're working through your points right now. Once the round is completed, you'll see here what we did with each point.

approved.title: Approved on {date}
approved.description: The project is complete from your side. We're now preparing the launch.

exhausted.title: Need another round?
exhausted.description: Write to us in the chat and we'll find a way together.

returned.title: We handed the round back to you
returned.description: You can edit your points again and resubmit the round. Here is what we still need:

discussion.title: We'd like to talk through your feedback
discussion.description: Before we start, a few points are easiest to clear up together. Let us know in the chat when it suits you.
discussion.chatLink: Find a time in the chat

completed.title: Round {number} is implemented
completed.description: Here you can see what we did with each point. We'll show you the next version as soon as it's ready.

approvalDue.title: The last round is implemented
approvalDue.description: Take a look at what we did with your points and approve the project if everything fits.

editor.bodyPlaceholder: e.g. “The hero image feels too dark, the team photo would be better”
editor.bodyRequired: Add a short note on what we should change.
editor.limit: More than {max} points don't fit into one round. Feel free to combine similar points.
editor.empty: No points yet. Add your first one – one point per request makes it easiest for us.

attachments.label: Attachments of point {number}
attachments.detachTitle: Detach from the point – the file stays in Files

draft.leaveWarning: Your latest changes aren't saved yet. Do you really want to leave this page?

conflict.title: Someone else just saved
conflict.description: You're now seeing the latest version. Your own unsaved points aren't lost.

submitDialog.title: Submit feedback?
submitDialog.description: We receive all points at once and get started.
submitDialog.final: After that, you can't change anything.

approveDialog.title: Approve project?
approveDialog.description: With your approval, the project is complete from your side. The remaining feedback rounds expire and we prepare the launch. This can't be undone.
approveDialog.descriptionLast: With your approval, the project is complete from your side and we prepare the launch. This can't be undone.
approveDialog.checkbox: I have checked everything and approve the project.

announcements.restored: Your version is restored and being saved.

errors.not_found: This feedback round no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.locked: This round just changed. You now see the current state.
errors.validation: Something is off with your input. Reload the page and try again.
errors.items_required: Add at least one point before you submit.
errors.item_text_required: Some points are still missing a text.
errors.items_present: You've already added points. Submit them instead of approving.
errors.not_latest: You can only approve in the latest round. You now see the current state.
errors.confirmation_required: Please tick the box to approve.
errors.attachment_limit: No more files fit on this point.
errors.not_attachable: This file can't be attached here.
errors.unavailable: That didn't work just now. Try again in a moment.

finalApproval.earlyHint: Everything fits already? Then you can approve the project now. The remaining rounds expire with it.
finalApproval.lastHint: If everything fits, approve the project. We'll then prepare the launch.

finalApproveDialog.title: Approve the project?
finalApproveDialog.description: With the approval, the project is complete on your side. The remaining feedback rounds expire, and we prepare the launch. This cannot be undone.
finalApproveDialog.descriptionLast: With the approval, the project is complete on your side, and we prepare the launch. This cannot be undone.
finalApproveDialog.checkbox: I have checked the results and approve the project.
